text: 香港金管局与证监会11月11日合办研讨会，聚焦Ensemble项目及代币化证监会认可投资产品，约200名业界人士出席。紧接金管局在2026香港金融科技周宣布EnsembleTX迈进新阶段，实现银行间代币化存款24/7全天候结算；证监会批准代币化货币市场基金进行24/7全天候二级市场交易。展望未来，Ensemble将引入更多具影响力的代币化用例、扩大交易规模，金管局将继续与证监会及业界合作，拓展代币化存款商业应用。（界面新闻）
text_en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the Securities and Futures Commission co-hosted a seminar on November 11 focusing on the Ensemble project and tokenized SFC-authorized investment products, with about 200 industry participants attending. This followed the HKMA's announcement at Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 that EnsembleTX has entered a new phase, enabling 24/7 round-the-clock settlement of interbank tokenized deposits; the SFC has approved tokenized money market funds for 24/7 round-the-clock secondary market trading. Looking ahead, Ensemble will introduce more impactful tokenization use cases and expand transaction scale, and the HKMA will continue to work with the SFC and the industry to expand commercial applications of tokenized deposits. (Jiemian News)
